title: Bat Fungus Killed 97% Of One Species
hook: Bat fungus killed 97% of one species.
closing: Losing bats also means losing billions of dollars in free insect control.
question: Can threatened bat populations recover before the fungus spreads farther?

segments.say: The bat fungus reached 35 states, turning a cave disease into a continental crisis.
Northern long-eared bats declined 97%, showing how one fungus can erase a common species.
Without bats, farm losses could reach 53 billion dollars as insect damage rises.
